## What landed

**D8–D14 mediated-egress repairs** (commit `bc5582d1`, prior worker `d832da43` rebased): thread-per-conn mediator bounded MAX_IN_FLIGHT 64 with the Store+lease behind a Mutex held only in `with_store` critical sections (D8); tunnel-pump half-close both ways, declared 600 s idle bound, true bytes + `close_cause ∈ {eof|idle_timeout|error:<kind>}` never `unwrap_or(0)` (D9); response hop-by-hop hygiene + exactly one framing member + `Connection: close` (D10); bodiless codec for HEAD/1xx/204/304 via `read_response_full_for` (D11); declared connect ≤10 s / first-byte-read ≥60 s constants, lapse → typed `EgressError::Timeout` → 504 (D12); streaming `forward_head`/`BodySource` in the binary path with bounded RSS — the buffered `forward` API + 128 MiB bound stay for in-process callers, per the contract's own fallback (D13, no deferral owed); `Host` omits `:80`/`:443` (D14). `crates/hh-env/tests/r6_45k.rs`: 11 hermetic loopback regressions, all failing pre-fix (XO-05 recorded below), 11/11 green post-fix.

**The conformance harness** (`scripts/egress-conformance/`): `extract.py` mechanically derives the member set — the 14 re-proof members (newest `*-fp-wc*-tasklists.json`) ∪ their pre-re-proofed successors (fp-w1 trial members) = 34 members, 610 committed `staging/tests/*` files → `derived/` (unique apt/pip/uvx/bootstrap lines; `check-derived.sh` is the drift guard). One `ubuntu:noble` container builds the subject `hh-egress-mediator` + `hh-cell-relay` for its arch; the mediator starts with `h-run`'s exact argv; `--policy` is the phase layer rendered by the new `hh-w1 render-policy` **through the same `admit_allowlist_mediated` + `phase_schedule` code path** (a regression asserts byte-identity vs the in-test render); relay binds `127.0.0.1:3128`; proxy/no_proxy env verbatim as `render.rs::closed_env`. Shapes S1 (apt→curl→uv installer→uvx), S2 (pytorch-index — typed deny under epoch-3 / success under epoch-4), S3 (pip), S4 (heavier apt), S5 (agent-phase pip/npm/apt + the github.com deny probe — Q-X55). Assertions → `verdict.json` (`hh-egress-conformance/1`): exits, every `requested`→`decided` (`request_ref`), zero 5xx, `close_cause eof` + true bytes, expected denies, per-step walls + peak :3128 concurrency (the D8 proof).

**`egress-real-clients` live leg** (R-4, ADR-0363): registered in `scripts/live-verify.sh` (ticket R6.45k, `public-upstream`, $0, no NAMEs), runs the committed harness via docker — `HH_EGRESS_SUBJECT_REF` selects the code under test (default HEAD). `live-verify.yml` gains the optional `subject_ref` input (dispatch-only + `environment: live-verify` unchanged — the "Local + manual workflow" ruling holds).

**D16 → epoch-4 (R-6, A4):** the mechanical scan (`hh-w1 scan-hosts` = committed `scan_hosts_in_text`, never re-implemented) over all 610 member `tests/*` files names exactly 5 hosts; `download.pytorch.org` is the ONLY one absent from the epoch-3 verify set — `pytorch-model-cli`'s committed `test.sh` names it verbatim (`uvx --index https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu`). Cause: a derivation-INPUT gap, never a scan bug — the epoch-3 `--verify-extra` derivation omitted the dev successors' `tests/*`. The derivation is now mechanical (`scan-verify.sh` regenerates the input set and fails on any scanned-but-ungranted host — the standing guard). Epoch-4 minted: `docs/build/reports/2026-11-16-fp-egress-allowlist-freeze-epoch-4.json` (+`.sha256`), digest `sha256:785d7092…`, verify += `download.pytorch.org` only; agent/permanent_denies/withheld byte-identical (X-06); amendment record `2026-11-16-fp-w1-q-x55-amendment-epoch4.md`; `check-fp-allowlist-amendment-epoch4.sh` all legs OK.
